_about: Shipped configuration of the reporting pipeline (paper Section 5: Algorithm 1, Algorithm 2 and Table 4, shipped defaults). Every value the paper labels as shipped is here. Inputs from the task specification (classes, alias map, matching rule, loss) and the per-item budget are supplied by the user per task.

request.format: one JSON object; record list first, then counts_by_type
request.count_instruction: Write the full list first; after it, give counts_by_type for the records you listed.
request.allowed_class_names: listed in the format (from the task specification)
request.scan_order: row by row, top to bottom

coordinates.gpt61: 0-1000 grid of the image as sent
coordinates.gem38: 0-1000 grid of the image as sent
coordinates.sonnet55: pixels of the image as sent; image pre-resized so the provider does not resize it again

request.reasoning_setting_applies_to: count requests (paper Table 4, Count row); set error and screen-source F1 use the lowest setting for every model, detection-source F1 uses set_f1_configuration, clicks use views.clicks.basic_tier_setting or click_tier

decode.salvage: if the whole response does not parse, recover each balanced {...} object that has the record fields
decode.invalid_records: records outside the class vocabulary after the alias map, or outside the frame, are kept in the audit pool and excluded from the delivered set

recovery.flagged_response: one follow-up request that attaches the previous answer and asks for the complete answer under the same contract; keep it if it carries no flag, otherwise keep the first response and its flags

clicks.crop_pixels: native, no resizing beyond provider limits

sets_and_counts.external_view_planner: optional input: a list of crops from any view planner (for example the companion paper's safe decomposition, which needs every target inside some view and a one-object overlap). Each view is one call; records are mapped to image coordinates and merged across views by the association rule.
sets_and_counts.confirmation_with_views: optional: crops whose merged report confirms the whole-image result. coverage_aware: a view confirms or rejects only records that lie wholly inside it; records that no view contains are kept. plain: every record needs confirmation.

token_geometry.gpt61: 32 px tokens on the image as sent (companion-paper calibration data for GPT-6.1: 1024x1024 gives 1,247 input tokens)
token_geometry.sonnet55: 28 px tokens on the image as sent
token_geometry.gem38: fixed grid of about 1,090 tokens per image

association.boxes: same class, IoU >= 0.5 (class-agnostic for screen parsing)
association.points: same class, within the task tolerance

set_error_over_reporting_families.keep: records reported by all three calls
set_error_over_reporting_families.interface_setting: list interface, lowest setting for every model

set_error_under_reporting_families.interface_setting: list interface, lowest setting for every model

unreadable_call._about: A call that still has no readable answer after recovery counts as an empty report, so three-call unanimity keeps nothing on that image; this is the construction evaluated in the paper. 'exclude' drops the call from support counting instead (replayed in stageB/analysis/out/pipeline_replay.json).

readout.count: list count of the final set; if the source list is flagged and a stated count exists, the stated count (status count_from_statement)

optional_labels.fewer_than_3_images: keep the shipped default; report the labelled error
optional_labels.3_or_more_images: switch to a menu configuration only if its mean paired advantage over images minus one standard error is positive
optional_labels.5_to_10_images: may fit the record gate (logistic selector on output features)

task_family_regime._about: over: models mostly report false objects; under: models mostly miss objects. Shipped per task family from source-side evaluation (paper Table 4).

set_f1_configuration._about: Single-call interface and reasoning setting per model for F1 on detection-type set tasks, chosen by the leave-one-source-out rule (paper Table 16) applied to all four detection sources (paper Table 21; stageB/analysis/e3_loso_config.py). list: one list for the whole image; regions: one row per region of a fixed coordinate registry. Not used for set error, where the construction of 'construction' applies.

click_tier._about: Algorithm 2 of the paper (clicks from several models). Implemented by gui/code/decision.py (c_rule, configuration 'D'); requests are built by gui/code/conf_stages.py.
click_tier.run_if: the per-item budget covers the worst case: 15 calls besides technical retries (3 first clicks, 3 zooms, 3 scores, at most 6 comparisons); otherwise one model's two-stage zoom
click_tier.zoom: two-stage zoom as in views.clicks; a failed zoom keeps the first click; a failed first click gives no candidate
click_tier.representative: member with the highest scorer hit score; ties: earlier source
click_tier.ranking_key: (representative's scorer hit score, cluster size, earliest source in the cluster)
click_tier.comparison: both orders; a representative wins only if both answers name it; failed, undecided or split pairs give no win
click_tier.output: representative of the cluster with most wins, ties among those broken by the ranking key; no wins: first cluster of the ranking; no point from any call: no answer (a miss)
